name: smwmusic-kirby-s-dream-land-green-greens-star-mix
title: Kirby's Dream Land - Green Greens (Star-mix)
description:
Did a short arrangement of Green Greens from Kirby's Dream Land. Always felt this song would work well as a Starman theme, despite Kirby already having his invincibility lollipop theme. Best used with the Super Mario World Styled Kirby by Kusamochi.

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. C (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. C# Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
ㅤ3. B Minor (Custom Pitch 2)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Enables the Intro (INTRO Enabled)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. Skips the Intro (INTRO Skipped)
